# The build script of the test package `someone/gen`: writes the module
# its code imports as `generated`, naming the version of its
# build-dependency `numbers`, and defines the build option `gen_LEVEL`.

import numbers;
import [File, Path] from io;
import os;

main(): int {
    var out = Path(os.environment("PEP_OUT_DIR").value());
    var text = "export made_with(): String {\n    return \"numbers " + numbers.numbers_version() + "\";\n}\n";
    if (File.write_text(out.join(Path("module.pep")), text).is_err()) {
        return 1;
    }
    print("pep:build-option=LEVEL=2");
    return 0;
}
